name: Winding Path to Victory
description:
Some take shortcuts for the sake of victory, while others have no choice but to do so. 
<High Tide>Unable to deploy on flooded tiles. Allied units and enemies in the water will suffer from 'Erosion': Allied units have reduced ASPD, continually receive Corrosion and receive additional Corrosion when attacked; Enemies have reduced ASPD and Movement Speed, and continually lose HP

abilities.text: Quickly loses HP while under the effects of 'Erosion'
Has a chance to dodge Physical attacks when not blocked
Immune to Erosion. While in water, gains increased ATK and <$ba.invisible>Invisibility</>
